card.name: Early 20th-century European political history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, the, of, and) in history passages about World War I and the interwar years, just before a treaty, leader or nation is named.

modes.label: Before treaty names
modes.description: Linking words leading into a named treaty after World War I.
modes.example: Hungary's modern borders were first established after World War I when,<< by>> the terms of the Treaty of Trian

modes.label: Before political leaders
modes.description: Words or punctuation just before a named prime minister, party or leader of the era.
modes.example: 1930 - Conservatives, led<< by>> R.B. Bennett, win a majority

card.writes: It suppresses 'National' and carrier words and promotes 'King' words, which suggests a push toward royal or leader titles.
